findings.subject: The adoption record of amendment 001 is bound to the observation plan by reference only
location: MH-PLAN section 6, row 'The adoption record lies outside the source set'
findings.issue: The row asks the observation plan to bind the record separately; the plan's schema is closed (_plan_shape refuses any other member), so it cannot. The plan binds it through C and the tree, and M0 checks only HEAD's ref, never the tree or the record's bytes. W2 explains this but does not list it among D1 to D4.
findings.effect: None on M0 and M1, which do not read the record (HOST's design_revision and amendments are observer constants). The record is exactly its blob at C; this review record carries its SHA-256, size, mode and blob.
findings.recommendation: The Director records that, for the observation plan, the row is met by this review's static binding, not by the plan. The S6 configuration binds the bytes through amendment_adoption, and its review compares them with sha256 872312ed80a63fbb196c17ace42e786b7fe757b710eff41139b125dfaa507937, 5,396 bytes, 0o644, blob 0431fab527c6bb69d52e224cac73c524ea6f70a3.

findings.subject: The empty stderr of both --version starts is predicted, not established
findings.issue: Neither environment has HOME. Static facts show no route to a stderr write but cannot exclude one; Apple's Git changes were not read.
findings.effect: A refusal costs one counted other start for Git (before Node starts), or both starts for Node. No corrected plan can change the environments or the predicate, so the cause would lie in the implementation and MH stops (MH-PLAN section 8).
findings.recommendation: The Director records this classification before the run, so that such a refusal is not treated as a plan error and retried with a new plan.

findings.subject: A framework-interpreter process that MH did not start runs on this host
findings.issue: PID 1304, parent launchd, started 2026-11-23T12:21:13Z (44 s after boot), runs the bound process image <framework>/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python with a file-watcher script of another project on the same volume (one-second polling). Its environment sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; its argv has no -B. N-09's hand-over note reaches sessions, not launchd jobs.
findings.effect: None so far: the framework inventory is unchanged across MP's after-snapshot, N34-M, W2's two computations and W3's two, all within this process's lifetime. A bytecode write would make M0 refuse: before any start if present at the first binding, or with DRIFT after a counted start if it falls between two rechecks inside observe.
findings.recommendation: Note the process in the run record and leave it as it is, since it is the owner's job outside the project. The Director's static immediately before observe detects any change. If the owner prefers, the job can be paused until MH ends.

findings.subject: M1 is the first execution of the prepared bin/node on this host
findings.issue: MP, N34-M, W2 and this review started no Node. Any first-launch work falls inside M1's 3,000 ms active window: the page-in of 122.5 MB from the external volume, code-signature validation, and any assessment that the system makes of a newly seen executable. Static facts: no com.apple.quarantine attribute (only com.apple.provenance); the volume is mounted without noexec or quarantine; the file is signed and its bytes are the pinned official ones.
findings.effect: A timeout or a refused execution would be a counted Node start that fails; since the limits are fixed, MH would stop.
findings.recommendation: Nothing changes in the plan. Run observe with the volume mounted and awake, and with no other heavy work on it.

q6_open_questions_and_deviations.Q-A: No static evidence of a stderr write for either --version under the HOME-less environments, but none can be excluded statically. Git: the arm64 slice embeds 'git version %s\n' and the configuration variables it reads; in upstream Git, --version becomes the version builtin, run without repository setup, printing to stdout, and with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 no configuration is looked up through HOME. Apple's changes were not read. Node: --version prints from the C++ start-up before V8, ICU and OpenSSL; the binary holds the C string v24.22.1. Consequence: a non-empty stderr refuses with OUTPUT-STDERR after the counted start; no plan can change the fixed environments or the predicate, so the cause lies in the implementation and MH stops (PR-02).
q6_open_questions_and_deviations.Q-B: Accepted: with -I the cwd is not on sys.path, the observer resolves nothing relative to it, children run in their stages, static ran from it; the capture paths meet FC-K2 (static's capture: PR-05).
q6_open_questions_and_deviations.Q-C: Agreed: a remount or reboot fails closed, before any start at static_observation, or after a counted start if it happens during observe. The volume is APFS, removable, ownership ignored, nosuid, nodev, not noexec, not quarantine; do not eject, unmount or let it sleep before observe ends.
q6_open_questions_and_deviations.Q-D: Confirmed at s02 and s08: plans 0o644, receipts 0o600, archive 0o444, bin/node 0o755, NODE-SOURCE.json 0o644.
q6_open_questions_and_deviations.Q-E: Informational: REUC records earlier conflict resolutions; the index has no conflict stage, equals the tree, and M0 never reads it.
